Approved technique: 기록광 추출 · 결전식. Draw action: 빛으로 고문서의 마나 층을 분리해 기록 흔적을 읽는다. Skill category: spell. Effect: 무기·손·접점 한 곳에 힘을 응축한 단일 발동. 짧은 검광 또는 국소 빛 효과.. Element: 빛. Limits: 준비된 도구·시야·거리와 마나 유지가 필요하며 국가 규모·무제한 효과가 아니다..
Regional context: 벨로아, 농경·기병·기사 문화; terrain 왕도 주변 산업·기사학교와 관료 파벌. Background is an understated appropriate medieval fantasy environment supporting action, no extra named locations invented.
LOW restrained tier: a single narrow concentrated effect at hand/weapon/contact point. No full body aura, no enormous beams, no elemental storm. Proficient yet contained.
Camera: close three-quarter from right, diagonal foreground perspective. Dynamic weight shift matching technique, visible hands properly connected to weapon/tool; defense/support stays defense/support, never converted into destruction. Keep face prominent and readable for an eventual face crop (face width roughly 16-22% of entire canvas). Focused, character-appropriate emotion, not automatic smile. Not front-facing standing portrait.
Style: polished 2D anime/cartoon fantasy in SAME visual quality as references, clean linework, rich readable game colors and painterly cinematic lighting. Background and effects fully painted as OPAQUE image. Wide horizontal 16:9 PNG ideally 1920x1080 or larger. Safe edges for face and key weapon/gesture. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, frames, watermark or split panels. ONE character only. Absolutely SOLO character: no enemy bodies, hands, crowds, silhouettes, or extra figures. Do not draw an opponent, the threat remains outside the picture.  Weapon and equipment held naturally at the grip, no duplicate swords or extra limbs.
